tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250mar me'i skong bshags kyi bkol byang bzhugs so// 1$0000290na maḥs manta bha drā ya:

mar me rgyas par byed na lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am: bsdu na gcig gam lnga'am gsum bshams la: hūm̐: bhandha rin chen 'bar ba'i kong bu ru: zhun chen rtsi mchog 'bru bcud mar khus gtams: sreg mar 'bar ba'i sgron me legs spar ba'i: mun pa'i dpung 'joms 'od gsal mar me 'dis: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: rang lus kha dog dbyibs gzugs kong bu ru: sha khrag rus pa'i bcud bsdus mar khus gtams: dbang po lnga yi sgron me legs sbar ba'i: snang stong zung 'jug 'od gsal mar me 'dis: rig 'dzin 'dus pa mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: rang ngag phra ba rtsa yi kong bu ru: 'gyu byed rlung gi bcud bsdus mang khus gtams: smra brjod sgra yi sgron me legs spar ba'i: grags stong dbyer med 'od gsal mar me 'dis: che mchog 'dus pa yi dam thugs dam bskang: rang sems mi shigs thig le'i kong bu ru: gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i bcud bsdus mar khus gtams: rang rig gsal ba'i sgron me legs spar ba'i: rig stong dbyer med 'od gsal mar me 'dis: rig 'dzin 'dus pa bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: de yan skong ba'o: bshags pa ni: gzung 'dzin rtog yul skyes pa'i nyon mongs sgrib: dam can 'dus pa sprul sku'i spyan sngar bshags: bskang ngo bskal pa'i mchod pas thugs= gso 'o sku yi dam tshig nyams chag gso: nyams chag skong zhing rtog sgrib byang gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du stsol: 'dzin rtog sems las skyes pa shes bya'i sgrib: che mchog 'dus pa longs sku'i spyan sngar bshags: bskang ngo bskal pa'i mchod pas thugs= gso 'o gsung gi dam tshig nyams chag gso: nyams chag skong zhing rtog sgrib byang gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du stsol: gnyis snang phra mo gnas ngan len gyi sgrib: rig 'dzin 'dus pa chos sku'i spyan sngar bshags: bskang ngo bskal pa'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang:

gso 'o thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag gso: nyams chag skong zhing rtog sgrib byang gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du stsol: chos rnams rang bzhin zung 'jug ma rtogs pa: sku gsum dbyer med thig le'i klong du bshags: bskang ngo bskal pa'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang: gso 'o dam tshig nyams chag thams cad gso: nyams chag skong zhing rtog sgrib byang gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du stsol: skong bshags bkol ba rig 'dzin thugs kyi gter: skal ldan don du mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyis: yi ger bris nas bdud 'joms rdo rje la: gdams pa gtad nas smon lam mthu rgyas btab: gu ru 'jam dbyangs bla mas spyan drangs nas: dad ldan snying gi bu la gdams pa 'o: : 1$0000300
